en:
My hair bristles,
lifting my helm.
I lean on the rail;
the rain has ceased.
I raise my eyes
and roar to the sky,
my heart ablaze.
Thirty years' glory:
mere dust and dirt.
Eight thousand li
of cloud and moon.
Waste no time,
lest a young head
turn white, and then
you grieve in vain.
Jingkang's shame
is not yet avenged;
a subject's wrath -
when will it end?
Our chariots shall
break Helan's pass!
Hungry, I'll feast
on invaders' flesh;
laughing, I'll drink
the Xiongnu's blood.
Let us start afresh,
win back our lands,
and report to court!
